phase_1.action: Add an exact Authorization header match check.
phase_1.logic: if (req.headers.get('Authorization') !== `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}`) { return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Unauthorized' }), { status: 401, headers: { ...corsHeaders, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }) }
phase_1.details: Ensures these system-invoked Edge Functions are strictly accessible only via backend systems holding the service key. It checks that the Authorization header matches exactly.

phase_2.logic: const authHeader = req.headers.get('Authorization'); const authClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, { global: { headers: { Authorization: authHeader } } }); const { data: { user }, error } = await authClient.auth.getUser(); if (error || !user) return 401;
phase_2.details: Requires public callers to be authenticated to prevent brute forcing coupons.
